points: Genuine human creativity takes time, but you know what doesn't?
There are countless AI models out there that can make something that passes for music, and you might come across those tracks on streaming services without realizing it.
Google says it will begin labeling that content in YouTube Music, building on similar disclosures in the main YouTube app.
